title: MX-Speed Pro Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Suomy MX-Speed Pro Gloss Black is delivers competition-grade off-road impact absorption with maximum cooling throughput, delivering lightweight balance and wide-vision goggle accommodation. Featuring a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber architecture at a featherweight 1340g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~100 dB aero profile. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Lightweight carbon motocross helmet with ALCANTARA interior.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Gloss Black finish; Suomy MX-Speed Pro is a dirt/MX specific helmet designed for off-road motocross use.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Suomy MX-Speed Pro Gloss Black: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Suomy's Dirt / MX lineup, the MX-Speed Pro Gloss Black brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Suomy MX-Speed Pro Gloss Black represents Suomy's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~100 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Suomy MX-Speed Pro Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
